reviews.title: Great addition!
reviews.comment: Yes its worth the price, paired with the official boom arm and mic it is amazing, price could be better so I definitely think its worth buying used like new or on sale, the build is good and no signs of wear after lots of use!
reviews.author: Israel Hernandez

reviews.title: Nice mount at a good price
reviews.comment: Works as described. The Elgato Wave 3 is a nice mic and deserves all the accessories you can throw at it, especially when they are priced this well.
reviews.author: Ben

reviews.title: Works Great
reviews.comment: Works great. I don't know what else to say. Bumping my desk no longer creates unwanted noise.
reviews.author: hi

reviews.title: Bit overpriced but it does its job.
reviews.comment: Price wise it's quite overpriced, specially when you compare it to the mic it attaches to but at least the frame is metal. It does what it needs to do just fine and reduces the impact of any vibrations from bumping the mic or mix arm if using one.
reviews.author: Giratina
